title: Meta Will Let Parents See What Teens Ask Its AI
brief: Meta has made parental supervision available globally in its Meta AI app. Parents can see broad topics their teenagers asked about during the previous seven days, but not the actual conversations, and can choose a more restrictive setting. The story gives parents and students a clear question about safety, privacy and whether topic summaries are enough. End with: Should parents be allowed to see AI topics but not the chats?

Translate that into a familiar comparison: an AI assistant that can book, buy or send things should have a stop button that a person—not the AI—controls. End with: Should every powerful AI tool have a human emergency brake?
